Companion Animal Travel Desk

Preparing for Companion Animal Travel

This article is for travelers who are arranging a trip with a companion animal through Aurelia Skyways. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk helps make the process clear, calm, and dependable so you can focus on your journey and your pet's comfort.

When you contact the desk, our staff reviews the travel details and checks the animal's needs with care. We look at the type of carrier, the animal's temperament, and any comfort or handling notes that may affect the trip. Every animal is treated with patient attention by trained staff, and handlers use calm, humane methods around animals at all stages of the process.

A welfare coordinator also reviews comfort needs before travel is confirmed. This extra step helps us identify anything that may support a smoother experience, such as a quieter setup or additional attention during handoff. We want each companion animal to move through the journey with as little stress as possible.

Before travel day, it is helpful to keep your animal familiar with its carrier and to pack the items allowed for the trip. Bring any needed documents and be ready to follow the guidance shared by the desk. Clear preparation helps reduce delays and gives the team the information needed to support your booking.

At the airport, our staff will guide you through the handover process and explain what happens next. We work carefully and respectfully so you know your companion animal is receiving proper attention. Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and that means keeping communication steady and service centered on animal well-being.

If you need help at any stage, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for support and next-step guidance.
